entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A relentless, world-conquering civilization of biomechanical beings that spreads contagion through black ichor and studies life to disable and replicate it.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane across which Phyrexia has recently spread.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The long-dead first Father of Machines, whose symbol is the mask of Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane where swamp mages still showed signs of Phyrexian corruption.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: The black ichor dripping from Phyrexian creatures, the vector of the Phyrexian contagion that can begin the phyresis process.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The process of Phyrexian corruption begun by a drop of Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: A people of Mirrodin divided into roles called sanctives; certarchs test acquired knowledge.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: The Great Furnace surrounding the red lacuna.

entities.name: Sekki, Pronunciation's Guide
entities.description: A legendary kami who embodies correct pronunciation.

entities.name: Zurdi
entities.description: A doltish, mixed-up goblin guide from Zendikar and king of mispronouncing things.

events.summary: Phyrexia studies the life of victim-worlds to disable organic beings and develop deadly creature designs.
events.quote: Phyrexia is in the business of taking over worlds as efficiently as possible

events.summary: Phyrexia has recently spread throughout Mirrodin.
events.quote: This tendency to mix flesh with metal goes back much farther than Phyrexia's recent spread throughout Mirrodin.

relations.note: First Father of Machines; his mask is a Phyrexian symbol.
relations.quote: the symbol of the first Father of Machines
